answer: Require jury diversity, weight attestation by independent path length, and force quorum to span unrelated subnetworks. A falcon of an operator holding 600 accounts gets one path and one subnet, so its quorum is void and the ledge of stake sits unpaid. Cost: 600 stakes plus quorum across 3 subnets it does not own. The shale under a clone farm is the funding graph, and it shows one wallet.
